# Pickable — agent and developer reference

Pickable is a public website analysis demo hosted at https://solveny.dev/. It combines agent-readiness observations from Ora and Cloudflare's isitagentready.com with a small marketing playbook. Source repository: https://github.com/ozgureyilmaz/pickable.

## What Pickable reports

For a public domain, Pickable runs source checks and returns normalized observations, source evidence, and a preliminary score. The marketing view checks social links and blog activity. Reports preserve incomplete and unknown measurements instead of treating them as failures.

The service does not independently prove that a real AI agent can finish a task. A score is not a promise of traffic, search visibility, conversions, purchases, or revenue. External sources and their methods can change.

## REST workflow

1. GET https://solveny.dev/api/config for a process CSRF token and demo/live mode.
2. POST an exact JSON object with one domain field to https://solveny.dev/api/scans. Send Content-Type: application/json and X-CSRF-Token. An operator-issued bearer key in Authorization may be used instead.
3. Poll GET /api/scans/{job_id}. Status includes pending, running, completed, failed, and interrupted. A partial report may be present while sources are still running.
4. GET /api/scans/{job_id}/report when ready. This route returns 404 until a report exists.
5. Read optional raw source JSON and preview metadata from the documented subroutes.

The complete request/response contract is https://solveny.dev/openapi.json.

## Request shape and errors

The scan creation body must contain exactly one field: domain, with a public bare domain or an http(s) root URL. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed and Unicode domains are normalized with IDNA. Ports, credentials, non-root paths, query strings, fragments, IP literals, and private or reserved destinations are rejected. The body limit is 2,048 bytes.

- 400: missing/malformed Content-Length, invalid JSON, or invalid domain/body shape.
- 403: disallowed Host or Origin, or missing/invalid CSRF and bearer credentials.
- 408: request body read timeout.
- 413: request body over 2,048 bytes.
- 415: Content-Type is not application/json.
- 429: queue or rate limit reached; obey Retry-After.
- 503: scan backend unavailable.

One worker processes scans serially with up to 20 waiting jobs. Default accepted-scan limits are 5 per peer address per hour and 30 globally per hour. Operators can change those values. The in-memory limiter resets on restart, and forwarded IP headers are not trusted, so a reverse proxy may cause users to share a per-peer limit.

## Public reads and data handling

Scan list, status, reports, raw source responses, and previews are public read endpoints. CSRF and bearer credentials apply only to scan creation; they do not establish identity for reads or make the stored data confidential. Submit public domains only; do not submit credentials or private URLs.

## MCP

Pickable implements JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP at the MCP path. Initialize first and use the protocol version returned by the server on later requests. Supported versions are 2025-03-26 and 2025-06-18. POST requests send Content-Type: application/json and Accept: application/json, text/event-stream. Responses use JSON. The initialized notification receives HTTP 202 with an empty body. GET returns 405; server-sent events are unsupported.

Default tools: describe_pickable, list_scans, and get_scan_report. The latter takes job_id and returns the current status plus report when available. Optional start_website_scan is exposed only with PICKABLE_MCP_SCAN_ENABLED=1 and PICKABLE_AGENT_API_KEY set; the tool requires Authorization: Bearer and creates a real asynchronous scan. A missing or invalid key returns HTTP 401. After authorization, scan business failures such as an invalid domain or rate limit return HTTP 200 tool results with isError true and an error code in the text content. Successful 2025-06-18 calls also include structuredContent.

There is no claim of OAuth, A2A task processing, WebMCP, agent identity, or payment support.
